title: Peer profile
description: What a peer declares about itself: served at GET /.well-known/bos-peer, or printed by `<tool> capabilities --format json` for a peer with no server. Unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: Contract id with its major version, e.g. bos.peer/v1.

unsupported.description: What a partial implementation leaves out, e.g. anonymize.

features.description: Optional features of the contract the peer implements. record_access (on bos.access/v1): the peer holds record_access entries and the `under` of each record, and allows a record-level read when the two meet. bos sends entries and `under` only to a peer that lists it, together with the grant shapes (represents) the entries need. principal_identities (on bos.access/v1): the peer maps bos principals to its own identity space; bos sends the external identities (issuer and subject) of the principals a set names only to a peer that lists it. A value this version of bos does not know is ignored.

represents.description: The grant shapes the peer can express and enforce. A shape not listed is one the peer denies.

erase.description: Delete a subject by its bos address.

hold.description: Refuse to delete or expire a held subject.

erase_derived.description: Trace and erase what the peer derived from a source: embeddings, indexes, caches, conversions, summaries.

max_staleness_seconds.description: Seconds after its last applied access set at which the peer denies instead of allowing. Required: a peer that never denies on a stale set cannot be bound.

health.description: Path of the health endpoint, or the CLI verb for a peer with no server.
